notes.title: Important optimization, level reset
notes.content:
1. Optimized the highway and outdoor checkpoints
2. Optimized the lighting, now there is also a better experience in medium and low image quality
3. Reset the jumping music level, now you can pass the level better, and you can also use the safety exit to enter the next level
4. Some fixes and optimizations

notes.title: The game demo is free now! Let's experience the horror journey together!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is my first time making a game. I am responsible for the entire development of the game.

I like horror themes very much, and my favorite horror movie is "Hereditary"
My favorite horror game is "The Face", and my favorite horror comic is "The Vortex"
I am glad that I can develop a horror game by myself.

[h1]1. Demo is online![/h1]
"Nightmare" is a horror puzzle game with very simple operation. The scenes in it are all from my dreams.
If you are interested in my game, welcome to experience this exciting nightmare journey. The game demo is currently available for free trial.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503340/Nightmare/][/url]

[h1]2. Experience Feedback[/h1]
If you encounter any problems or need suggestions during the trial, please feel free to give us feedback. You can send us an email at 2243247594@qq.com or leave a message in the community.
With your help, the game will become better and better!
